# ferentin_endpoint_destination_rules (Data Source)

List every endpoint destination rule in the tenant, in evaluation order (ascending `priority`; equal priorities, which the platform allows, are listed by name).

Every item carries `import_id`, the ID its resource's `import` block takes, and `managed_by`, who created it (`console`, `iac`, …). Filter on `managed_by = "console"` to find what Terraform does not manage yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every endpoint destination rule, in evaluation order (ascending priority).
data "ferentin_endpoint_destination_rules" "all" {}

output "rule_ladder" {
  value = [for r in data.ferentin_endpoint_destination_rules.all.rules : format("%04d %-5s %-7s %s", r.priority, r.action, r.managed_by, r.name)]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant to list. Defaults to the provider's.

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String)
- `catalog_slug` (String)
- `destination_hosts` (List of String)
- `destination_kind` (String)
- `device_group_ids` (List of String) Null = every device in the tenant.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `import_id` (String) `<tenant_id>/<rule_id>`, for an `import` block.
- `last_modified_by` (String) Who wrote it last. Divergence from `managed_by` means it changed hands.
- `managed_by` (String) Who created it: `console`, `iac`, `cli`, `system` or `unknown`. Never changes.
- `name` (String)
- `priority` (Number)
- `rule_id` (String)
